translations.text: Then suddenly, afraid and sad, I began these grim verses in song, just as you said; I remembered my sins, the wrongs of my life, and the long time, and the dark coming of death on earth.
Sinful tongue, now that you have a time ready for forgiveness, now that the Almighty, guardian of the kingdom of heaven, gladly hears you with attentive ears?
Now you must weep and shed tears while there is time and a season for weeping. Now it is healing for a person to weep here and do penance to please the Lord.

Remember also in your mind how great the punishment is that the wretched will suffer for their former deeds, or how terribly and how awesomely the King of high majesty will judge each and every one here according to their former deeds,
when the heavenly troops come, a mighty host stirred up, and the whole army of angels throngs around and surrounds the Eternal One, the glorious Creator, with might and majesty.
On top of all this, the whole upper air will also be filled with poisonous flame.

No one there can be confident in his own deserts when near the Judge. Instead terror will run through everyone together, through the thoughts of the heart, and bitter weeping too, and there the whole wicked crowd will stand stiffened, most like stone, expecting evil.
These things will overwhelm the mind and speech of every person by their greatness.
There, to cause sorrow, the smoky flame and the fierce ice are mingled together, very hot and very cold, in the midst of hell.
There no voice sounds except harsh weeping and wailing, nothing else. Nor is the face of any creature seen there, except those of the tormentors who torment the wretched.

On top of all this, the wretched breast will be terrified and afflicted with bitter care over why the sinful flesh, in that perilous time, committed so many sins against itself that it should be tormented in prison, where the terrible eternal punishments are.
There cruel sorrow will be everywhere, and sickness, anger and sloth. And there sinful souls also burn and run about in flame in a dark pit.

That is Mary, best of maidens. She, most blessed of all, leads [?] through the beautiful shining kingdoms of the glorious Father, between Father and Son, with a noble company, and among the counsellors of the kingdom of eternal heavenly peace, the guardians of the heavens.

What can be hard here in this life, if you will tell the truth to whoever asks, compared with being allowed to live fearless among that company for eternity, and to enjoy bliss without end from then on in the blessed seats of the heavenly ones?"
